places-tenada-de-cueva-moreno-letreros-d.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-tenada-de-cueva-moreno-letreros-d.story: 167 km from Letur to Letur, about 2 h 53 of riding. It goes by way of Abrigo de la Rambla de Pedro Izquierdo, Abrigo del Engarbo, Letreros de los mártires and back through Abrigo del Engarbo. The highest point is about 1,450 m. The line favours views over speed.
